title: Reference-Grounded Instrument Transformation Matching
dataset: TinySOL v3 isolated musical notes, Zenodo 3633012
blocker: Material duplicate of the existing Shipd challenge 'Same-Instrument Matching Across the Register' found in both C: and D: shipd_domain_challenge_docs mirrors.
notes: Claimed after active-registry and accepted-example duplicate audit.
Proposed task is reference-conditioned listwise audio matching over native instrument, pitch, and dynamics relations rather than TinySOL's canonical instrument-recognition or pitch-estimation tasks.
Official Zenodo metadata reports CC BY 4.0; source files total 899,882,029 bytes.

Abandoned before platform upload: the existing Same-Instrument Matching Across the Register challenge already uses a query note, six hard timbre candidates, cross-register instrument identity, hidden pitch/loudness metadata, and learned candidate selection. Demonstration pairs, offset heads, ranking, and NO_MATCH do not create enough distance from that core contract.
